summary: {worker} has a date for the last class and an expiration date later that same week.
realLife: Goosen described a dispenser due to earn her remaining credits on June 10 against a June 14 deadline. He wanted someone at the department who could answer the timing question. In June 2026 Freeman asked about a common annual renewal date to help dispensers plan their credits. Mossberg said that would require legislation and recalled the workload when renewals had once come due together.
inGame: needs: course completion and expiration dates.

turns.pulledBy: The school posts the credit promptly.
